ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR( IF(MONTH(Contract_End_Date__c) = 12, Contract_End_Date__c <> (DATE( YEAR(Contract_End_Date__c) + 1, 1 , 1 ) - 1), Contract_End_Date__c <> (DATE( YEAR(Contract_End_Date__c), MONTH(Contract_End_Date__c) + 1, 1 ) - 1)) ,
Contract_End_Date__c < Contract_Start_Date_MOU_Date__c,
Contract_End_Date__c > DATE( YEAR(Contract_Start_Date_MOU_Date__c) + FLOOR((MONTH(Contract_Start_Date_MOU_Date__c) + 36) / 12), MOD(MONTH(Contract_Start_Date_MOU_Date__c) + 36, 12) + 1, 1 ) - 1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contract End Date has to be Last Day of the Month, and it cannot be greater than 36 Months from MOU Month.
